name: native-messaging
description: Firefox and Chromium native messaging with a Jco-built component

scripts.build:component: jco componentize src/component.js --bundle --wit wit --world-name component --out component.wasm --disable http --disable fetch-event
scripts.build: pnpm run build:component && pnpm run transpile
scripts.all: pnpm run build && pnpm run test
